title: Agent Retrospective
description: Self-improving feedback from an agent run. The magicWand field is the most important — one concrete wish for a better experience.

workedWell.description: What about the experience worked well? Be specific about WHY.

confusing.description: What was confusing, unclear, or required trial-and-error?

magicWand.description: If you had a magic wand, what ONE thing would you change? Name a specific command, flag, format, or workflow improvement.
